scope: Read-only restored cycle-boundary state analysis; solver restore/array reads only, no relaxation or growth.

definitions.phase: C is the completed active crossing update at the actual cutoff boundary; C+1 is after one inactive relaxation and growth update.
definitions.sigma: Checkpoint sigma is a lattice-cell supersaturation field from cycle-boundary state, not solved boundary sigma_b or a newly converged solution for the post-update geometry. Attached-cell field values are omitted as nonphysical.
definitions.fill: f is the preserved per-cell fill fraction. Attached cells have f=1; comparisons concern explicitly unattached cells.
definitions.patch: Fourteen sites: radius<=1 in z=-1,+1 relative to the seed center. Rim summaries are fixed-coordinate rings radius2 in z=-1,+1 or -2,+2, not inferred facet classes.
definitions.recovery: Replay matched original scientific event prefixes; original complete switch states were absent, so there is no independent full-state comparison to an original checkpoint.
definitions.causality: Comparing states from different histories does not isolate geometry, fill or vapor causality. No state was transplanted or changed.

receipt.scope: Fresh HIL replay; exact scientific event prefix matches BLD except operational RSS. Original full switch state absent, so no independent original full-state equality claim.
